title: Assassin & Cinderella
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Neneko, a clumsy spy, is sent to seduce Omi, the top assassin of a rival organization, and learn his weaknesses. He sees through her at once but, instead of killing her, proposes marriage so her employer won't learn she failed. The adult pair's marriage of convenience mixes romantic comedy, fan service and a darker spy-thriller mood.
life_message: Love can grow inside a pretense, and devotion matters more than the dangerous work two people do.

content.note: Omi is a professional killer; one ANN reviewer jokes about 'pretty boys drenched in blood'; AniList and MangaUpdates tag assassins and assassination.
Reviewers call it darker than Spy x Family; threat of death hangs over Neneko.

Adult couple; art lingers on Neneko's body (ANN); 'erotic thriller feel' (Otaku USA); publisher rates it 18+/Mature; MangaUpdates genre Smut; AniList Nudity tag. First volume teases more than it shows.

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Rival organizations settle matters by killing; Omi hides Neneko's failure to protect her standing.

Order vs freedom.evidence: Couple acts outside their organizations' orders while still bound by them.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Spouse loyalty overrides duty to each employer.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Spy and assassin organizations run on rank; Omi is the 'ace' and holds power over Neneko.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: No religious frame; marriage is an old institution used as a modern contract.

Survival vs self-expression.evidence: Neneko marries first to stay alive; romance grows later.

folkways.japan: The contract-marriage romance and the spy-family setup follow popular Japanese genre conventions rather than Japanese family norms.

delivery.evidence: ANN reviewers find no clear message, just 'a premise and some funny moments'; Otaku USA stresses mood and style.
delivery.note: The series is driven by mood, romance and fan service rather than argument.

winners_losers: Neneko survives and gains a devoted husband; the organizations that would use or kill her are sidelined. Sympathy goes to the couple and to possessive devotion as romance.
to_verify: Sexual content in later volumes: Otaku USA says a cliffhanger points to more explicit material; MangaUpdates lists the genre Smut; publisher rates it 18+. Consider a skip review if later volumes center on sex.
